name: Quiet West: Butcher noose
source:
Ruthless soldier William Blackwood was betrayed, then rescued by a woman who changed him forever. Their quiet life ended when a deadly sickness swept the Wild West, threatening the Butcher family. We must take up his fight to save them.

[From [url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/quiet-west-butcher-noose]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
无情的士兵威廉·布莱克伍德遭到背叛，然后被一个永远改变了他的女人所救。当一场致命的疾病席卷狂野西部并威胁到布彻一家时，他们平静的生活结束了。我们必须加入他的战斗来拯救他们。

[来自[url=https://squidsquadpapi.itch.io/quiet-west-butcher-noose]Itch.io[/url]]
